definitions.deployment: a green run of CI on main (one row of metrics-raw.md; each attempt of a re-run is a row of its own)
definitions.failure: a red run of CI on main; cancelled runs are neither a deployment nor a failure
definitions.change_lead_time: from the first commit of the merged PR (for a direct push, the commit itself) to the completion of the first green run on main created at or after the change reached main; the queue is part of it
definitions.change_fail_rate: red runs / (green + red runs) on main
definitions.recovery_time: from the completion of a red run on main to the completion of the next green run on main; consecutive red runs form one incident
definitions.period: UTC dates of run creation, inclusive
